TPC-H+V embedding reconstruction report

What this is: a fidelity spot-check of the embedding fixtures. Text (p_text_embedding, ps_text_embedding) is a lossy mean of GloVe word-vectors — decoding = nearest GloVe words to the row vector; green = the word is in the original text. Image (ps_image_embedding, DEEP1B) content is NOT reconstructable (deep CNN descriptors + PCA are not invertible), so only the relational nearest-neighbour structure is shown. Deterministic fixed samples; no raw DEEP1B content is emitted.
